Requirements.SystemGoal: Event-driven Smart Home Automation System: sensors publish events through EventBus, actuators subscribe and react, controller coordinates scenarios. System runs in-process, no external services, verified by deterministic tests.

UseCase.Name: Event publish / subscribe
UseCase.Description: EventBus accepts events from publishers and delivers to all registered subscribers.

UseCase.Name: Smart home orchestration
UseCase.Description: SmartHomeController creates EventBus, registers all sensors and actuators.

UseCase.Name: Deterministic verification
UseCase.Description: pytest covers each use case. All tests deterministic, no external deps.
